notes: New: 8 more EQ presets, 2 new reverb presets, 3D Sound Stage, Volume Boost, Stereo Widener, Mains Hum Filter, and Taddy as a 5th podcast source - Sound Zone now brings every sound setting into one screen. Open audio files from other apps straight into Music, use new App Shortcuts (long-press the icon) and a Quick Settings play/pause tile, and if Tarang ever crashes it can now offer to report it. Plus better background battery use, a fix for stations occasionally showing twice, and a batch of accessibility/description fixes across Settings, Sound Zone, and Local Music.
